independence_instructions: This is an AI-assisted audit and does not satisfy the independent-human annotation requirement.
Use only public task, quality, scenario, metric, overlay, source, and test evidence.
Do not inspect reference branches, solution patches, or model-generated answers.
rationale: IMAPClient has a strong utility/lexer to response-parser to high-level-client dependency chain. Typed response shapes, bytes/text normalization, date conversion, UTF-7, and search/fetch contracts create realistic downstream stale-assumption failures. The ownership split is natural but workload is highly asymmetric, and the identity capability decorator plus directly tested helper placeholders must be retained as disclosed bootstrap behavior and independently reviewed.
